g.text: 1 · Family acquisition — Aim 1: concentrate family participation
organic and AI search (15,000+ visitors/mo) · owned audiences (12,000+ community; 180,000+ video views) ·
paid channels under pre-registered rules · community partnerships · direct outreach
→ concentrated family participation in 12 markets · acquisition cost by channel
2 · Provider acquisition — Aim 2: concentrate provider participation
claim-your-profile outreach (phone, email, mail, conferences) · self-serve nationally, direct sales in active markets
→ active providers in the same 12 markets · activation rate
3 · Workforce acquisition — Aim 2: concentrate workforce participation
university relationships · pre-health advisors · student organizations · campus portals
→ staffed campus pipelines in the same markets · time-to-staffed-shift
4 · Demonstrated value → paid conversion — Aim 3: convert demonstrated value into recurring revenue
free pilot → measured value → subscription offer · inside sales · enterprise motion after local proof (Section 8)
→ paying providers, recurring revenue · conversion rate, ARPU, retention
